after.descriptionRef: Commit to a dependable close-range strike.
after.flavorLine: The front gives way to a measured blow.

after.descriptionRef: Strike enemies in the adjacent ring; separated enemies limit the payoff.
after.flavorLine: A planted turn turns pressure into reach.

after.descriptionRef: Attempt to remove Guarded before a lower-Power piercing strike. Equipment Armor bypass has no extra benefit when equipment Armor is absent.
after.flavorLine: A defense is an opening once its rhythm is known.

after.descriptionRef: Gain Guarded and a small Barrier. Barrier remains until spent; the longer cooldown and equipped slot distinguish this from Basic Guard.
after.flavorLine: A steady stance keeps the next choice yours.

records.role: Support two chosen members of the line

after.descriptionRef: Choose up to two distinct Self/Ally recipients for modest HP recovery and one Damage Up application.
after.flavorLine: Resolve travels farther when the line answers together.

after.descriptionRef: Trade direct Power for a one-tile push that still obeys Rooted, occupancy and landing rules.
after.flavorLine: One hard step buys room for the next.

after.descriptionRef: Once per battle, damage that crosses below 30% HP can spend 4 MP to recover 8% maximum HP and gain Guarded. HP costs are not damage and do not qualify.
after.flavorLine: The line holds for one more breath.

records.role: Advance into a chosen two-target engagement

after.descriptionRef: Walk at most one legal tile as part of the full cost, then strike up to two distinct adjacent enemies from the position actually reached.
after.flavorLine: A short advance changes the whole engagement.

after.name: Unbroken Strike
after.description: Commit to a powerful close strike and recover HP only if the hostile attack connects.

skill.descriptionRef: Commit to a powerful close strike and recover HP only if the hostile attack connects.
skill.flavorLine: A wavering line becomes a single unbroken answer.

after.flavorLine: A wavering line becomes a single unbroken answer.

records.rationale: Preserve the universal cost/recovery floor while distinct Discipline play cycles are rebalanced; the complete captured record remains editable.

after.name: Move
after.description: Walk through legal terrain within your remaining Movement.

records.rationale: Preserve the universal cost/recovery floor while distinct Discipline play cycles are rebalanced; the complete captured record remains editable.

after.name: Basic Attack
after.description: Strike using your higher Physical or Mystic Attack.

records.rationale: Preserve the universal cost/recovery floor while distinct Discipline play cycles are rebalanced; the complete captured record remains editable.
Preserve the universal cost/recovery floor while distinct Discipline play cycles are rebalanced; the complete captured record remains editable.

after.name: HP Recovery
after.description: Recover a percentage of your maximum HP.

records.rationale: Preserve the universal cost/recovery floor while distinct Discipline play cycles are rebalanced; the complete captured record remains editable.

after.name: MP Recovery
after.description: Recover a percentage of your maximum MP.

after.descriptionRef: Restore 10% maximum HP to one chosen Self/Ally recipient.
after.flavorLine: A measured light finds the wound that matters now.

after.descriptionRef: Restore 12% maximum HP to one Self/Ally recipient at or below 35% HP. The emergency condition buys a cheaper but less freely available rescue.
after.flavorLine: A small remaining breath is enough to work with.

after.descriptionRef: Grant one Self/Ally recipient 20 Barrier, which remains until spent. This prevents future damage rather than restoring lost HP.
after.flavorLine: Shelter arrives before the blow.

records.role: Scheduled recovery instead of urgent triage

after.descriptionRef: Deliver three scheduled recoveries of 4% maximum HP, beginning next round. Each application obeys the native recovery clock and recipient state.
after.flavorLine: The promise of another breath takes root.

after.descriptionRef: Restore 5% maximum HP to Allies in the adjacent Circle footprint and 3% maximum HP to yourself. Formation and real missing HP determine the value.
after.flavorLine: Safety has a shape, and the line must choose to hold it.

records.role: Triage coupled to a brief protective window

after.descriptionRef: Restore 6% maximum HP and apply Guarded for one affected round to one Self/Ally recipient.
after.flavorLine: A rescued breath should survive the next answer.

after.descriptionRef: Deal 12 Mystic Power and apply one Healing Down application for two affected rounds on a connected attack.
after.flavorLine: The same knowledge that mends can deny relief.

records.role: Weaponize an affliction without pretending to remove it

after.descriptionRef: Copy eligible Debuffs from yourself to the selected enemy, then attack with 10 Mystic Power and recover 5% maximum HP only if the attack connects. The original afflictions remain; no eligible copy does not prevent the rest of the attack.
after.flavorLine: What wounds you can become the opening you needed.

records.role: A shared-cooldown choice between pressure and two-recipient rescue

after.name: Verdant Rupture
after.description: Choose a ranged recovery-denying attack with confirmed-hit personal recovery, or an expensive two-recipient cleanse and rescue. Both choices share the same four-owner-turn cooldown.

skill.descriptionRef: Choose a ranged recovery-denying attack with confirmed-hit personal recovery, or an expensive two-recipient cleanse and rescue. Both choices share the same four-owner-turn cooldown.
skill.flavorLine: Life answers the moment with either a wound or a way through it.

after.flavorLine: Life answers the moment with either a wound or a way through it.

records.counterplay: Line of sight, Mystic Defense and closing inside the firing lane limit it.
records.interactionCase: One target; one 25% Mystic Power contribution, paid once.

after.descriptionRef: A dependable ranged Mystic attack. Its moderate price leaves room for another decision.
after.flavorLine: A clean thought becomes a bright wound.

records.counterplay: Stay outside the one-tile ring or exploit its MP expenditure.
records.interactionCase: Ally and actor are excluded; every affected enemy receives the same single damage packet.

after.descriptionRef: Strike enemies in the one-tile ring around you with Mystic damage. It is immediate close-range coverage, not a remote explosion.
after.flavorLine: A broken circle of light answers the encirclement.

records.counterplay: Unprotected targets make the dispel investment inefficient; Mystic Defense still applies.
records.interactionCase: Guarded is removed before damage; no explicit equipment-Armor or Defense bypass is claimed.

after.descriptionRef: Remove Guarded and Burn Ward from one enemy before a Mystic strike. This dispels those named protections; it does not bypass Mystic Defense.
after.flavorLine: A precise thread finds the seam in the ward.

records.counterplay: Enemies can leave the radius before the cast; cleanse Exposed or conserve spacing. No direct damage is included.
records.interactionCase: Enemy-only Circle2 applies Exposed and drains exactly 4 MP without transferring it to the caster.

after.descriptionRef: Expose enemies in the two-tile ring around you for two owner turns and drain 4 MP from each. This is an immediate pulse, not persistent Ground.
after.flavorLine: The air itself seems to weigh their defenses.

records.role: Delayed mana recovery when reserves are low
records.counterplay: Spend AP now and survive until the queued recovery; it cannot be cast while reserves are healthy.
records.interactionCase: The MP threshold is checked before payment. A single scheduled recovery cannot recursively pay AP.

after.descriptionRef: While at or below half MP, invest this action in a 12% maximum-MP recovery beginning next round. It cannot solve an immediate payment shortfall.
after.flavorLine: Stillness gathers what haste has scattered.

records.role: Protection that competes with mana readiness
records.counterplay: Mana denial can prevent the cast; sustained damage spends the Barrier and repeated protection costs AP.
records.interactionCase: Check the reserve threshold at S0, then pay MP once and grant one flat Barrier amount.

after.descriptionRef: While at or above half MP, spend 6 MP to gain 20 Barrier and Guarded for one owner turn. Barrier lasts until spent; no expiration turn is promised.
after.flavorLine: Unspent possibility hardens into a shield.

records.counterplay: Its damage is lower than a focused release; spacing and line of sight constrain both selections.
records.interactionCase: Each distinct chosen enemy receives one damage packet and Suppress; duplicate targets are illegal.

after.descriptionRef: Choose up to two distinct enemies within three tiles. Strike each with Mystic damage and Suppress for one owner turn. The sparks do not bounce to unselected units.
after.flavorLine: Two intentions, one sudden silence.

records.counterplay: Low HP, payment thresholds and interrupted actions make the commitment dangerous; spent costs are not refunded.
records.interactionCase: All three resources pay atomically; a damage-threshold reaction cannot be triggered by the HP cost.

after.descriptionRef: Spend AP, MP and 20 HP on a committed Mystic strike. HP payment leaves at least 1 HP and is not damage.
after.flavorLine: The last safe measure is deliberately exceeded.

records.counterplay: Keeping reserves ready competes with other spells; the ring requires close positioning, and the extra packet still faces Defense.
records.interactionCase: The readiness gate uses prepayment MP. The two packets together include only one 25% Mystic Power contribution.

after.name: Aether Nova
after.description: Strike the two-tile enemy ring with Mystic damage. If you begin the cast with at least 75% MP, add a separate 5-Power packet with no extra Power scaling.

skill.descriptionRef: Strike the two-tile enemy ring with Mystic damage. If you begin the cast with at least 75% MP, add a separate 5-Power packet with no extra Power scaling.
skill.flavorLine: A held constellation collapses all at once.

after.flavorLine: A held constellation collapses all at once.

records.counterplay: Close to adjacent range, break line of sight or use Physical Defense.
records.interactionCase: No Mark or setup is required; minimum range remains real.

after.descriptionRef: A dependable Physical shot at an enemy two to five tiles away.
after.flavorLine: The line is clear. The decision is yours.

records.role: Walking-tempo pressure instead of hard immobilization
records.counterplay: Cleanse Slow, remain in a useful firing position or attack without walking.
records.interactionCase: A connected shot applies Slow; a miss applies neither damage nor the target status.

after.descriptionRef: Deal modest Physical damage and Slow an enemy for two owner turns. Slow increases walking AP cost; it does not reduce Movement allowance or prevent attacks.
after.flavorLine: The next step becomes the costly one.

records.counterplay: Single targets make the spread inefficient; cover and range constrain every selected enemy.
records.interactionCase: Each selection is independent and duplicates are illegal; no target receives three shots.

after.descriptionRef: Choose up to three distinct enemies within four tiles and fire a modest Physical shot at each. Only chosen enemies are included.
after.flavorLine: A practiced hand divides a single opening.

records.counterplay: Revealed and Mark have finite clocks; cleansing Mark denies the accuracy setup. This action deals no damage.
records.interactionCase: Sensory uses the real Covert purge and Revealed rules; another attacker does not inherit this source’s Mark bonus.

after.descriptionRef: Use Sensory to expose one enemy for one owner-turn start and apply your Mark for two owner turns. Mark improves only its source’s accuracy; it is not shared bonus damage.
after.flavorLine: There. The opening has a name.

records.counterplay: Close within three tiles, break sight or pressure the primed archer; invalid targeting retains the prime, but a paid interrupted release consumes it.
records.interactionCase: The actual Controlled prime is free, its ready overlay stays inside the existing artwork, and release is paid once.

after.descriptionRef: Prime once per battle for free, then release a committed Physical shot at an enemy three to seven tiles away. Release pays the full listed cost; leaving the firing lane can deny it.
after.flavorLine: A breath held for the right horizon.

records.role: Directional lane pressure with the honest Pierce boundary
records.counterplay: Step out of the cardinal lane; this is weaker focused damage than Aimed Shot and does not bypass Physical Defense.
records.interactionCase: Each enemy in the legal lane is hit once; without explicit equipment Armor the bypass contribution is zero.

after.descriptionRef: Fire down a cardinal four-tile lane. Physical Defense still applies. The configured 50% equipment-Armor bypass has no extra effect where explicit equipment Armor is absent.
after.flavorLine: One lane. No wasted motion.

records.role: A small retreat and field recovery
records.counterplay: Rooted and occupied routes constrain the move; the modest recovery costs an offensive opportunity.
records.interactionCase: Use the actual reached position, pay only this Skill’s 40 AP, and retain spent Movement after the recovery.

after.descriptionRef: Move up to two legal tiles as part of this Skill’s price, then recover 4% maximum HP. No walking surcharge is added; Rooted, terrain, occupancy and remaining Movement still matter.
after.flavorLine: Find ground worth holding, and breathe.

records.counterplay: The extra price competes with another action, and a miss or paid interruption keeps the cost spent.
records.interactionCase: Only an explicitly selected Farstrider Attack receives this command-owned modifier, including its prepaid packets.

after.descriptionRef: Explicitly attach this modifier to a Farstrider Attack command to pay 10 AP and 3 MP for 15% extra outgoing damage on that command. It does not attach itself or affect unrelated Basic Attacks.
after.flavorLine: Let the rest of the battlefield fall quiet.

records.counterplay: Cleanse Mark or force a mixed marked/unmarked selection to deny the added packet; no extra targets are inferred.
records.interactionCase: All chosen enemies must satisfy the pre-cast Mark predicate. Total scaling remains one 25% Physical Power contribution per enemy.

after.name: Deadeye Barrage
after.description: Choose up to two distinct enemies two to six tiles away for a decisive Physical barrage. If every chosen enemy already bears Mark, add a separate 4-Power packet with no extra Power scaling.

skill.descriptionRef: Choose up to two distinct enemies two to six tiles away for a decisive Physical barrage. If every chosen enemy already bears Mark, add a separate 4-Power packet with no extra Power scaling.
skill.flavorLine: Every prepared line meets in the same instant.

after.flavorLine: Every prepared line meets in the same instant.
